interface.name: astrea_shortcuts_manager_v1
interface.description: Registers client-owned shortcut resources. Matching and ownership policy are compositor-side; this protocol only receives compositor-dispatched shortcut events. For the reserved astrea-shell namespace, each namespace/name pair has one live owner. A newest valid registration replaces the previous owner, which receives cancelled, and the replaced owner is never restored by ordinary registration. Version 2 also provides a conditional registration request for clients recovering from cancellation; that request fails without replacing an existing owner. Other namespaces retain their existing shared registration behavior.

request.name: register_shortcut_if_available

description.summary: register only when no owner exists

request.description: Registers a shortcut only if its namespace/name pair currently has no live owner. An occupied slot is reported through the new resource's rejected event and the existing owner is left untouched.

interface.name: astrea_shortcut_v1
interface.description: A registered shortcut receives compositor-dispatched shortcut lifecycle events for its namespace/name pair. pressed is an initial action, repeated is a key-repeat action, released is an explicit release-trigger action. cancelled means ownership was replaced. Version 2 rejected events report an authorization failure or an occupied conditional registration. Synthetic actions such as alt_tab_commit are separate logical action presses; they are not releases of another shortcut.

event.name: registered

description.summary: registration was accepted by the compositor

event.description: Confirms that this shortcut resource became the live registration for its namespace/name pair.

event.name: rejected
event.description: reason 1 means Astrea shell authorization failed. Reason 2 means a conditional registration found an existing owner. Rejection never changes the current owner.
